metaDescription: Payments that come back every week, month or year, and what is coming up next.
title: Bills and regular payments
intro: Rent, EMIs, subscriptions, bills and salary: payments that come back on a rhythm, found in your own entries. Dates and amounts are estimates from what happened before.
empty: We have not found regular payments yet. They show up once a payment repeats, for example rent paid two months in a row. Upload a few months of statements to see them.
tileOutNote_one: About this much a month, {count} payment
tileOutNote_other: About this much a month, {count} payments
tileInNote_one: About this much a month, from {count} source
tileInNote_other: About this much a month, from {count} sources
estimateNote: These are estimates from your past entries, not promises. A payment can come a few days early or late, or change.
soonTitle: Coming up in the next {days} days
ownTitle: Regular moves between your own accounts
whenMissed: Expected around {date}, but it is not in your statements.
whenUnseen: Was due around {date}. Your statements do not reach that far yet.
whySeenTwice: Why we think so: seen twice so far, a month apart
why_one: Why we think so: {count} payment since {since}
why_other: Why we think so: {count} payments since {since}
homeTitle: Coming up in the next {days} days
homeNothing: No regular payments expected in the next {days} days.
fcBelowZero: Your balance may go below zero around {date}. At its lowest, about {lowest} around {lowestDate}.
fcHowStart: Starts from your balance of {amount} on {date}.
fcHowStatementEnd: That is where your statements end; anything since then is estimated too.
fcHowDaily: Takes off about {amount} a day for everyday spending: your average over the last {days} days.
fcHowLeftOut_one: {count} big one-off payment is left out of that average.
fcHowLeftOut_other: {count} big one-off payments are left out of that average.
fcHowRegular: Adds the regular payments and income from your Bills page on their usual dates.
fcHowIrregular: Money that comes in at odd times is not counted, so this errs on the careful side. It is an estimate, not a promise.
fcNoHistory: We need at least three weeks of entries for this account to make a forecast. Upload more statements, or check back later.
fcOld: This account's statements end on {date}. Upload a newer one to see a forecast.
fcNoBalance: This account's statement has no balance column, so we do not know how much is in it. Upload a statement that shows the balance to see a forecast.
fcSeeBills: See all bills and the full forecast
whySeenOnce: Why we think so: a subscription service, seen once so far. We guess it renews monthly; another month's statement will tell.
